text: BAM share rose 0.1 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.14 percentage points over 7 days, putting BAM at 32.9% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.5% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 58 top-node leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not validator turnover.
